# UI/UX and Product Design
Activate for interface, navigation, dashboard, and interaction work. Inspect existing journeys and components first. Preserve clear status, feedback, and confirmation patterns. Verify touch targets, keyboard use, RTL/LTR, responsive layouts, loading/empty/error states, and reduced motion. Never redesign protected workflows by assumption.
